steps.goal: Navigate to the team settings area where members are managed
steps.instruction: Open Settings to manage your team.

steps.goal: Open the invite dialog from the Members section (not the top-nav duplicate)
steps.instruction: Click Invite in the Members section.

steps.goal: Enter the teammate's email, then send the invitation
steps.instruction: Now click Send invite to send the invitation.
steps.waitingInstruction: Enter your teammate's email address to continue.
